1) * grid_pitch\n    block_depth = 2 * margin + pocket_diameter + (rows - 1) * grid_pitch\n\n    # Base solid block\n    base = box(block_width, block_depth, total_height)\n\n    # Create pocket cylinders\n    pockets = []\n    for col in range(columns):\n        for row in range(rows):\n            # Pocket center position\n            x = margin + pocket_radius + col * grid_pitch\n            y = margin + pocket_radius + row * grid_pitch\n            z = total_height - pocket_depth  # Base at z=3, extends to z=15\n\n            pocket = cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth)\n            pocket = translate(pocket, [x, y, z])\n            pockets.append(pocket)\n\n    # Union all pockets into single volume for subtraction\n    all_pockets = pockets[0]\n    for pocket in pockets[1:]:\n        all_pockets = union(all_pockets, pocket)\n\n    # Subtract pocket volume from base\n    result = subtract(base, all_pockets)\n\n    # Chamfer top edges: pocket mouths and outer perimeter\n    # 0.8 mm at 45 degrees\n    result = chamfer(result, 0.8, top=True)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":3,"newStart":1,"newLines":6,"lines":["+from nurb import part","+","+@part"," def bit_block(","     shank_diameter: float = 6.0,","     columns: int = 5,"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

1) * grid_pitch\n    block_depth = 2 * margin + pocket_diameter + (rows - 1) * grid_pitch\n\n    # Base solid block\n    base = Box(block_width, block_depth, total_height)\n\n    # Create pocket cylinders and subtract them\n    result = base\n    for col in range(columns):\n        for row in range(rows):\n            # Pocket center position\n            x = margin + pocket_radius + col * grid_pitch\n            y = margin + pocket_radius + row * grid_pitch\n            z = total_height - pocket_depth\n\n            pocket = Cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth, mode=\"a\")\n            pocket.locate(Location((x, y, z)))\n            result -= pocket\n\n    # Collect top edges for chamfering (pocket mouths and top perimeter)\n    # Edges on faces with normal pointing up (z > 0.9)\n    top_edges = []\n    for face in result.faces:\n        if face.normal.z > 0.9:\n            for edge in face.edges():\n                top_edges.append(edge)\n\n    # Chamfer top edges with 0.8 mm at 45 degrees\n    if top_edges:\n        result = chamfer(top_edges, 0.8)\n\n    return result\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":44,"oldLines":7,"newStart":44,"newLines":7,"lines":["     # Collect top edges for chamfering (pocket mouths and top perimeter)","     # Edges on faces with normal pointing up (z > 0.9)","     top_edges = []","-    for face in result.faces:","+    for face in result.faces():","         if face.normal.z > 0.9:","             for edge in face.edges():","                 top_edges.append(edge)"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":true}}

1) * grid_pitch\n    block_depth = 2 * margin + pocket_diameter + (rows - 1) * grid_pitch\n\n    # Base solid block\n    base = Box(block_width, block_depth, total_height)\n\n    # Create pocket cylinders and subtract them\n    result = base\n    for col in range(columns):\n        for row in range(rows):\n            # Pocket center position\n            x = margin + pocket_radius + col * grid_pitch\n            y = margin + pocket_radius + row * grid_pitch\n            z = total_height - pocket_depth\n\n            pocket = Cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth, mode=\"a\")\n            pocket.locate(Location((x, y, z)))\n            result -= pocket\n\n    # Collect top edges for polishing (pocket mouths and top perimeter)\n    # Identify top faces by checking Z coordinate of face center\n    bbox = result.bounding_box()\n    max_z = bbox.max.Z - 1) * grid_pitch\n    block_depth = 2 * margin + pocket_diameter + (rows - 1) * grid_pitch\n\n    # Base solid block\n    base = Box(block_width, block_depth, total_height)\n\n    # Create pocket cylinders and subtract them\n    result = base\n    for col in range(columns):\n        for row in range(rows):\n            # Pocket center position\n            x = margin + pocket_radius + col * grid_pitch\n            y = margin + pocket_radius + row * grid_pitch\n            z = total_height - pocket_depth\n\n            pocket = Cylinder(pocket_radius, pocket_depth, mode=\"a\")\n            pocket.locate(Location((x, y, z)))\n            result -= pocket\n\n    # Collect top edges for polishing\n    # Only chamfer: outer perimeter top edges + circular pocket edges\n    # Exclude internal edges between pockets\n    bbox = result.bounding_box()\n    max_z = bbox.max.Z - 0.01\n\n    top_edges = []\n    perimeter_edges = []\n\n    # Collect all edges on top faces\n    for face in result.faces():\n        center = face.center()\n        if center.Z >= max_z:  # Top faces\n            for edge in face.edges():\n                # Check if edge is on perimeter (large X or Y values)\n                # or if it's a circular edge (pocket mouth)\n                edge_pts = edge.bounding_box()\n                is_perimeter = (\n                    abs(edge_pts.min.X) < 0.1 or abs(edge_pts.max.X - block_width) < 0.1 or\n                    abs(edge_pts.min.Y) < 0.1 or abs(edge_pts.max.Y - block_depth) < 0.1\n                )\n\n                # Check if circular (pocket mouth)\n                is_circular = False\n                try:\n                    # Circular edges have specific geometry\n                    from build123d import Geom\n                    geom = edge.geom\n                    is_circular = hasattr(geom, 'is_circle') and geom.is_circle()\n                except:\n                    pass\n\n                if is_perimeter or is_circular:\n                    top_edges.append(edge)\n\n    # Polish collected edges with 0.8 mm chamfer\n    if top_edges:\n        result = polish(result, top_edges, 0.8)\n\n    return result\n","numLines":84,"startLine":1,"totalLines":84}}}
